displayIdentity.body: The rich are charged toward generosity and a future foundation. Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy; laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
